summary: ERGONOR AS (org. no. 976 605 608) is a private limited company (AS) based in Ullensaker, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-07-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 31 664. CEO: Kåre Høitomt; board chair: Kåre Høitomt; auditor: FRAM REVISJON AS. Also: LEI 549300U0BT9YJ6OKRT49.
